SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_complaint_article WHERE complaint_master_id = #{complaintMasterId} AND complaint_no LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix},'%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_complaint_article ( article_id, complaint_master_id, category_id, file_group_id, writer_auth_type, writer_member_id, writer_di_hash, writer_oauth_provider, writer_oauth_uid_hash, writer_name, writer_contact_enc, complaint_no, title, content, client_ip, status, answer_due_at, answer_count, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{articleId}, #{complaintMasterId}, #{categoryId}, #{fileGroupId}, #{writerAuthType}, #{writerMemberId}, #{writerDiHash}, #{writerOauthProvider}, #{writerOauthUidHash}, #{writerName}, #{writerContactEnc}, #{complaintNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{clientIp}, #{status}, #{answerDueAt}, 0, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_complaint_article SET status = #{status} WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE tb_complaint_article SET answered_at = NOW() WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND answered_at IS NULL
UPDATE tb_complaint_article SET closed_at = NOW(), status = 'CLOSED' WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE tb_complaint_article SET delete_yn = 'Y' WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
